qss_engineering_scenario.basis: Pinned site lap simulation, 450/600 kW, 1046 kg, AWD in both modes. Dry historical grip and aero held fixed. No activation detour, traffic or race-energy constraint. Envelope spans published grip scenarios for this layout; midpoint is the latest mapped event central scenario.

basis.time_scale_basis: event median with at least 90% timing-flag coverage
basis.am_method: observed signed AM fraction transferred; AWD contribution and power sensitivity varied
basis.ratio_method: Evo anchor × ((600/450)/(350/300))^a. Scenarios a = 0, 1/6, 1/3. Range widened symmetrically by the greater of the absolute matched generation step and the 75th percentile absolute event deviation of the anchor group. No weather-matched evidence yields null.
basis.assumptions: Fixed maximum power scenario. Exponents are assumed sensitivities. Aero format, race energy, tyres, and traffic have no separate measured Gen4 effect. For Gen3-only anchors add the matched mean step or assume zero if unknown. Event averages have one vote each; pooled generation steps have one vote per matched layout. Bounds are scenario limits, not confidence intervals.
